subject: Quick follow-up: hosted evaluation & quickstart items
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: hosted evaluation & quickstart items

Hi Emma — thanks again for your time on the demo earlier. Couple quick notes and asks so we can scope a hosted evaluation (fast path) versus recommending Dedicated or Private options: 

What I heard in the call (please correct any of these):
- Primary use case: user-facing summarization + search re-ranking from uploaded documents (PII filtered by FinLytics preprocess)
- Expected traffic profile: spikey during business hours, estimated average 8–12 req/s; peak bursts up to ~30 req/s
- Latency target: p95 under ~200ms for generation flows
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, data residency in US, potential later need for VPC/Private if audit requires it

To make the evaluation fast and low-friction, can you confirm the following: 
1) Who on your procurement/compliance team should I loop in for SOC2 evidence? (you mentioned a questionnaire)
2) Do you have an internal preferred start date for a sandbox/smoke test next week?
3) Are there any hard limits we should enforce from day 1 (e.g., max concurrent requests, token caps)?

Proposed hosted quickstart approach (we can adjust after your answers):
- Sandbox endpoints (hosted) provisioned with a dedicated API key for FinLytics
- Initial rate guidance: burst up to 50 rps across all keys, sustained 10 rps per API key; we’ll add prefix/KV caching suggestions for heavy repeated prompts
- Monitoring: token & latency breakdowns surfaced in Console; ops kickoff to set alert thresholds
- Timeline: sandbox access within 48 hours after SOC2 questionnaire + PO if required for extended trial

I attached the demo recording and will follow with a short ops plan (hosted quickstart) with concrete endpoint names and rate caps. If Hosted looks like a clear fit we’ll keep the same plan and talk about Dedicated sizing only if you need sustained hundreds+ rps or an isolated GPU pool.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15–30 min ops call with Ben (solutions) and Monica (onboarding) to finalize the sandbox start.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[hannah@redwood.com]
[Attachment: demo-recording.mp4 (video)]
From: Emma Cho <emma@finlytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: hosted evaluation & quickstart items

Hannah — thanks for the recap, that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Traffic: our internal projection is closer to avg 10 req/s with peaks up to ~35 req/s for short windows (campaign-driven). If you have burst smoothing we can accept short exceeds.
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms is what our UX team wants. If you need a little buffer at pilot that's ok as long as we track regressions.
- Data residency: must remain in US regions.

Procurement/compliance: I attached our SOC2 questionnaire and a contact alias for procurement.
- procurement@finlytics.com (please include for PO/contract redline)
- Compliance lead: Emma Cho (me) — I’ll own the questionnaire and initial review.

Start date: We can target a sandbox kickoff on Thursday 2028-06-07 AM PT.

Hard limits: we don’t have strict token caps yet but would like to start conservative (sustained 10 rps per key) and increase if the pilot looks stable.

[Attachment: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks — Emma
Emma Cho
Product Ops, FinLytics
emma@finlytics.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Wed, 06 Jun 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: hosted evaluation & quickstart items

Emma — perfect, thanks for the questionnaire and the procurement alias. I reviewed the SOC2 doc quickly and flagged one small ask (Ben will help with evidence collection).

Attached is a short hosted quickstart plan for FinLytics. Top-level proposal: start on Hosted API sandbox, instrument KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts, and keep an eye on cost/latency. If within 2–3 weeks you start seeing sustained >200 rps or need isolated resources for compliance we’ll move to a Dedicated sizing conversation.

Hosted quickstart plan (summary):
- Provisioning: sandbox API key and two endpoints: /v1/finlytics/generate (generation) and /v1/finlytics/embeddings (search embeddings)
- Recommended rate limits: endpoint /v1/finlytics/generate: burst 50 rps, sustained 10 rps per key; embeddings endpoint: burst 80 rps, sustained 20 rps per key
- Caching: enable prefix + KV caching for summary prompt templates (expect 30–40% token reduction for repetitive queries)
- Observability: we’ll set up a shared dashboard with token/latency breakdown and error rates; alert at p95 latency >300ms or error-rate >2%
- Ops kickoff: 30-min call to share sandbox credentials, walk through endpoints, and confirm alert thresholds

Ben — can you take the ops lead on the kickoff? Suggested times: Thu 2028-06-07 09:00 PT or Thu 11:00 PT. I’ll put a calendar hold tentatively for 09:00 PT.

[Attachment: hosted-quickstart-plan.pdf (pdf)]
